name: Calvarrasa de Abajo (Spain)
description: Square white flag with blue stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Calvarrasa de Abajo (a cauldron, keys and waves on yellow and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Calvarrasa de Abajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
